comments.author: @jamesanthonymarsters3498
comments.text:
Travel Lifestyle,

It was nice that you took the time to put this video together. While watching it, I even saw footage of my wife, myself and other members of our family on Palmerston Island. I am a 5th-generation member of the Marsters Family from Palmerston Island.

Unfortunately, some of the footage shown is not from Palmerston Island—it appears to be from another island and even another country. Some of the information you have provided is also incorrect.

We are disappointed that other people’s photographs and video footage appear to have been used without their permission and presented with your own version of the story.

On behalf of the Marsters family of Palmerston Island,    we respectfully ask that you review the entire video, correct the inaccurate information, properly identify all locations, acknowledge the original owners of the content and remove any material you do not have permission to use.

Please do the right thing and set the record straight.
